page.layout: One title page, centred. Upper part set in large capitals and roman type, partly inverted on the scan. Lower part in smaller roman type, with the imprint at the foot. A library stamp lies over the centre and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: tum Vetero Syro (quod fuit pauci) Aquila,
Typis Guil. Du Gard: Impensis Sam. Thomson
ad insigne Regis, in Coemeterio Paul

page.notes: Title page with a Bodleian Library stamp over the centre. The top lines are printed upside down on the scan. Several lines in the middle are too faint to read; the bracketed readings are approximate and the [?] marks show doubtful letters. The last line of the imprint is partly lost in the damage.
